contract_scope.definition: this gate defines the future rollback/no-op package contract only
contract_scope.does_not_create_executable: this gate does not create a rollback package executable
contract_scope.does_not_rollback: this gate does not implement rollback
contract_scope.does_not_restore: this gate does not perform restore
contract_scope.does_not_bind: this gate does not implement or execute binding
contract_scope.does_not_authorize: this gate does not authorize native execution, SetupAPI/Newdev, Windows mutation, driver action, artifact access, compile-output access, or metadata parsing

future_rollback_no_op_package_contract.future_package_status_family: NO_BINDING_NO_MUTATION_NO_NATIVE_IO unless separately authorized in a future lane
future_rollback_no_op_package_contract.future_package_evidence_only: future package must be evidence-only until explicitly authorized otherwise
future_rollback_no_op_package_contract.future_package_audit_required: future package must be independently audited before any mutation-capable task

future_package_validation_rules: validate operator confirmation ID equals operator-confirmation-c445630fbb303c7c
validate confirmation has not expired at future task time
validate accepted target instance ID exact match
validate accepted target chain exact match
validate PID_045E literal count in accepted target chain equals 0
validate VID_045E literal count in accepted target chain equals 3
validate shared container ID exact match
validate prior target identity exact match
validate prior parent identity exact match
validate prior child identity exact match
validate all safety counters are zero before any future mutation-capable task
validate no live/device query is performed unless separately authorized in a future task
validate no artifact or compile-output access is performed unless separately authorized in a future task
validate independent audit acceptance before any future mutation-capable task
future_no_op_rejection_rules: reject/no-op if operator confirmation is missing
reject/no-op if operator confirmation is expired
reject/no-op if operator confirmation ID mismatches
reject/no-op if accepted target instance ID mismatches
reject/no-op if accepted target chain mismatches
reject/no-op if PID_045E appears in the accepted target chain
reject/no-op if VID_045E count in accepted target chain is not 3
reject/no-op if shared container ID mismatches
reject/no-op if prior identity evidence is missing
reject/no-op if prior identity evidence mismatches target, parent, or child identity
reject/no-op if rollback/no-op package is missing
reject/no-op if rollback/no-op package is not independently audited
reject/no-op if execution authorization is absent
reject/no-op if SetupAPI/Newdev counters are non-zero
reject/no-op if Windows mutation counters are non-zero
reject/no-op if driver action counters are non-zero
reject/no-op if native library load or entry-point resolution counters are non-zero
reject/no-op if artifact or compile-output access is detected

future_restore_preconditions.restore_not_authorized: restore is not authorized by this gate
future_restore_preconditions.rollback_not_authorized: rollback implementation is not authorized by this gate
future_restore_preconditions.future_restore_requires_separate_auth: future restore must require separate explicit authorization
future_restore_preconditions.future_restore_requires_package_evidence: future restore must require accepted rollback/no-op package evidence
future_restore_preconditions.future_restore_requires_audit: future restore must require independent audit acceptance
future_restore_preconditions.future_restore_no_op_chain_mismatch: future restore must no-op if accepted target chain differs
future_restore_preconditions.future_restore_no_op_identity_mismatch: future restore must no-op if prior identity evidence is missing or mismatched
future_restore_preconditions.future_restore_no_op_unauthorized_action: future restore must no-op if SetupAPI/Newdev, Windows mutation, driver action, native execution, artifact access, or compile-output access is not explicitly authorized in that future task

audit_requirements: contract definition evidence must be validated before manifest/docs update
manifest/docs update must be audited before commit acceptance
future rollback/no-op package evidence must be independently audited before any mutation-capable task
future mutation-capable task must require separate explicit authorization and must not rely on this gate as authorization
explicit_non_authorization_statement: This contract definition gate does not authorize rollback package implementation, rollback implementation, restore, binding implementation, binding execution, native execution, SetupAPI/Newdev invocation, Windows mutation, driver action, artifact access, compile-output access, or metadata parsing.
